title: Israel Demands a King

questions.question: Why did Israel reject Samuel’s sons as judges?
options: They took bribes and perverted justice
questions.correctAnswer: They took bribes and perverted justice
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 8:3 (ESV): “...They took bribes and perverted justice.”

questions.question: What did Israel ask Samuel for?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 8:5 (ESV): “...Now appoint for us a king to judge us like all the nations.”

questions.question: How did Samuel feel about their request?
What did God say Israel rejected?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 8:7 (ESV): “...they have rejected me from being king over them.”

questions.question: What did Samuel warn the king would do?
options: Take their sons, daughters, and goods
questions.correctAnswer: Take their sons, daughters, and goods
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 8:11-17 (ESV): Describes taking sons for war, daughters for perfumers, fields, etc.

questions.question: Who were Samuel's sons?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 8:2 (ESV): "The name of his firstborn son was Joel, and the name of his second, Abijah..."

questions.question: The king will take the best of your fields and give them to whom?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 8:14 (ESV): "He will take the best of your fields and vineyards and olive orchards and give them to his servants."

questions.question: He will take the tenth of your grain to give to whom?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 8:15 (ESV): "He will take the tenth of your grain and of your vineyards and give it to his officers and to his servants."

questions.question: What did the people refuse to do?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 8:19 (ESV): "But the people refused to obey the voice of Samuel. And they said, 'No! But there shall be a king over us...'"

questions.question: The king will take your daughters to be what?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 8:13 (ESV): "He will take your daughters to be perfumers and cooks and bakers."

questions.question: In that day you will cry out because of your king, but the Lord will ______.
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 8:18 (ESV): "And in that day you will cry out because of your king... but the LORD will not answer you in that day."

questions.question: Samuel told all the words of the Lord to whom?
options: The people who were asking for a king
questions.correctAnswer: The people who were asking for a king
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 8:10 (ESV): "So Samuel told all the words of the LORD to the people who were asking for a king from him."

questions.question: After the people insisted, what did God tell Samuel to do?
options: Obey their voice and make them a king
questions.correctAnswer: Obey their voice and make them a king
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 8:22 (ESV): "And the LORD said to Samuel, 'Obey their voice and make them a king.'..."

questions.question: How did Samuel dismiss the men of Israel?
options: Go every man to his city
questions.correctAnswer: Go every man to his city
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 8:22 (ESV): "...Samuel then said to the men of Israel, 'Go every man to his city.'"

key_verse_text: And the LORD said to Samuel, “Obey the voice of the people in all that they say to you, for they have not rejected you, but they have rejected me from being king over them.” (ESV)
